summary: Iteration 3 tests for Fikirizm Cloud passed. Backend (13/13 in test_iteration3.py): budget export xlsx+pdf return proper binary payloads with butce_ prefixed Content-Disposition; non-member gets 403/404 on Operasyon export; task-budget-summary returned by GET /api/tasks/{id} for the 'Ödül ve madalyaları sipariş et' task with correct {count, planned, actual, currency=TRY} and absent/zero for tasks without linked budget; task privacy end-to-end (owner+admin see private task; member gets 403 on GET and task excluded from list; adding member to visible_to restores access); email-triggered endpoints (POST /api/tasks with assignees, PATCH /api/tasks assignees, PATCH /api/projects members) all return 200 and persist — confirming mailer is non-blocking. Frontend (Playwright on public URL): logged in as owner, opened Bisiklet Festivali > Bütçe, verified export-xlsx-btn and export-pdf-btn trigger real file downloads (butce_Bisiklet Festivali 2026.xlsx / .pdf). Opened 'Ödül ve madalyaları sipariş et' — task-budget-summary shows 'Bağlı Bütçe (1) ₺12.000 / plan ₺30.000'. task-visibility-select switches to 'Gizli' → task-visibleto-btn appears → 4 visibleto-<userid> options rendered and selectable. Task without linked budget (Sponsor anlaşmalarını tamamla) correctly hides task-budget-summary.

issues: React hydration warning: '<button> cannot be a descendant of <button>' — the visibleto-* items are <button> elements nested inside the Popover trigger's <button> tree via SelectItem/PopoverContent portal in some devtool paths. Not user-visible but pollutes console. Consider changing the outer trigger to a div with role=button or use asChild carefully.

Accessibility warning: 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle' shown for at least one modal/drawer (likely CommandDialog for Cmd+K or the task drawer itself). Wrap the visually hidden title using @radix-ui/react-visually-hidden.

action_items: LOW: Fix Radix accessibility warning 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle' (add VisuallyHidden DialogTitle for drawers/command dialog).
LOW: Fix nested <button> hydration warning in TaskDrawer visible-to Popover (avoid button-in-button).

PRE-EXISTING (from iter 2, not iter 3): Pytest regressions in test_iteration2 (TestBudgetPermission) fail now because member 'mert' is no longer a member of 'Ürün Geliştirme' — env drift from prior settings-test PATCH runs. Consider making these tests self-provisioning (owner adds mert as member in setup then removes) or seed mert into Ürün on startup.
critical_code_review_comments: routes.py has grown to 942 lines — well over the 700-line threshold. Split into resource-specific routers (auth/projects/tasks/budget/ideas/notifications) for maintainability.
Budget export endpoint should validate fmt in {xlsx,pdf} explicitly and return 400 on other values (currently defaults to xlsx; verify).

can_see_task uses task['visible_to'] and assignees but doesn't consider explicit share by created_by across visibility=project vs private consistently — ok now, but add unit test to protect the invariant.

Mailer helpers email_task_assigned/email_project_added must be wrapped in try/except at the call site OR internally to guarantee non-blocking behavior (tests indicate they are — good). Add an integration test with EMERGENT_EMAIL_KEY missing to prove request still returns 200.
Frontend BudgetView exportBudget catches all errors as generic 'Dışa aktarma başarısız' — surface backend error message for 4xx to aid debugging.
test_credentials: Owner ingobiosport@gmail.com/Fikirizm2025! + demo members Demo2025! — all working. Bearer JWT via localStorage 'fik_token'.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests created TEST_ prefixed tasks (TEST_no_budget_task, TEST_private_task, TEST_email_assign_task, TEST_email_patch_task) and TEST_email_proj project — all cleaned up in teardown. Frontend test toggled the real 'Ödül ve madalyaları sipariş et' task visibility to private and back to project; also added one member to visible_to and reverted. Final state: task visibility restored to 'project' but visible_to may contain one demo user (please verify or reset if needed).

Iteration_2 regressions in TestBudgetPermission are due to env drift (mert removed from Ürün Geliştirme by prior PATCH tests) — not a bug introduced in iteration 3. Owner test task 'Ödül ve madalyaları sipariş et' may have a modified visible_to list after UI test — reset via PATCH /api/tasks/<id> {visible_to: []} if needed.
